sections.Context and Goals:
This session focused on senior engineering design review of docs/design/got-query-audit-and-design.md (GoT Query System v2.8). The review was conducted as a principal engineer with 30+ years experience, validating technical claims through actual code execution.

Primary goals:
- Review design for correctness, completeness, and extensibility
- Validate technical claims against actual code
- Address specific questions about grammar, testing, and security
- Update CLAUDE.md with design review methodology
- Create handoff for continuation
sections.Key Technical Discoveries:
1. T-001-A Entity Type Dispatch:
   - EntityType enum only covers 5 of 12 entity types
   - Must use string-based dispatch with SchemaRegistry validation
   - Updated design document with implementation hints

2. DI Container for Testing:
   - New infrastructure discovered after merging main branch:
     - cortical/common/container.py - Container implementation
     - cortical/core/bootstrap.py - Application wiring
     - cortical/core/modules/got_module.py - GoT service registration
   - TransactionManager now accepts injectable store, wal, lock
   - Updated Section 7.3 to use container.create_child() pattern

3. SQL-Compatible Grammar:
   - NOT IN / NOT LIKE are compound operators, not separate modifiers
   - Precedence: NOT > comparisons > AND > OR
   - Added design intent documentation to Appendix B

4. Security Sprint Gate Pattern:
   - Security review at START of each sprint, not end
   - Added Section 7.7 with specific checklist
sections.Bug Fixed This Session:
KT Checksum Mismatch Bug:
- Symptom: CorruptionError when creating knowledge transfers
- Root Cause: TransactionalGoTAdapter.create_knowledge_transfer() in scripts/got_utils.py bypassed CDGStore and wrote files directly without checksum wrapper
- Fix: Modified create_knowledge_transfer() to delegate to TransactionManager.create_knowledge_transfer() which uses proper transactional storage
- Location: scripts/got_utils.py lines 2815-2875
- Verified: KT creation and retrieval now work correctly
sections.Files Modified:
1. CLAUDE.md
   - Added 'Senior Engineering Consultation & Design Review' section (review methodology, approval framework, patterns)
   - Added 'Search Before Creating (MANDATORY)' section to prevent duplicate functionality

2. docs/design/got-query-audit-and-design.md
   - T-001-A: Added critical finding about string-based dispatch
   - Section 7.3: Updated testing strategy to use DI container approach
   - Section 7.7: Added security sprint gate pattern
   - Appendix B: Added SQL compatibility design intent
   - Part 8: Added Review Recommendations
   - Status: DRAFT - Under Review (NOT yet approved)

3. scripts/got_utils.py
   - Fixed create_knowledge_transfer() to use TransactionManager delegation

data.summary: Conducted senior engineering design review of got-query-audit-and-design.md with iterative refinement. Key outcomes: DI container testing strategy, security sprint gates, SQL-compatible grammar, T-001-A string dispatch, and fixed KT checksum bug.
